description: Connect a third-party analytics provider (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, Umami) or remove it (provider 'none'). dotsy adds the provider's script to the <head> of every live page — live immediately, no publish needed. Replaces any earlier provider (one per site). Use this instead of pasting a GA4 gtag snippet into a layout. Other tags (Google Tag Manager, ads pixels, Clarity, search-console verification <meta>) go in set_custom_code.

domain.description: Plausible only: the site domain registered in Plausible, e.g. example.com.

host.description: Umami only: https origin of the Umami instance, e.g. https://umami.example.com.

measurementId.description: GA4 only: measurement ID, e.g. G-ABC123XYZ.

name: set_analytics_provider
